title: I built this game for my family and they're enjoying it
author: tahazsh
selftext:
I used Claude Opus 5.5 (high) along with some tools and harnesses I built to streamline the process. This is built in Godot and it has two full worlds and each level is designed in a way to challenge you and excite you, since it introduces new abilities and pickups as you progress.

It took time (about two weeks), not because it's complex to build, but because I spent a lot of time thinking about the levels design and how progression should work.

I got the assets from kenney.nl. So haven't generated most of the arts. I only needed to generate some of the pickups.

My goal was to also make it play well on phones and touch screens. So I spent a lot of time to ensure it's playable. You'll see touch screen buttons on these devices.

And to provide better experience, I installed them as PWA on my family's devices, which gets rid of the browser frame and provide better persistence support to save the game progress.

Btw, I even built this trailer with Claude. I think it's not bad 😅

You can try it here if you want: https://demos.tahazsh.com/shapeleon/

Hope you enjoy it!

comments.author: hyperg8_games
comments.body: bringing in a new ability or pickup with each level across two worlds is the hard part imho, from my experience abilities added one by one without planning the whole thing out end up biting each other later. did you plan all the abilities upfront before Claude built anything, and how do your harnesses split the work between level design and the code side?
